title: Sign in to mikaki
intro: Use your passkey to sign in securely.
recovery: If you lose all passkeys, this account cannot be recovered.
error: Could not complete the operation. Please try again.
loginConsentDescription: Sign in and share your account identifier with this client.
loginAuthorize: Allow and sign in with passkey
vaultIntro: Your display name is encrypted in this browser and unlocked with your passkey. If you lose the passkey, you cannot decrypt it.
vaultNotFound: No display name is saved. Unlock with your passkey to add one.
vaultLoaded: Unlock with your passkey to view your display name.
vaultReady: You can edit your display name. Saving will use your passkey again.
vaultSaved: Saved. Unlock with your passkey to verify it.
vaultUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
vaultPrfUnsupported: This passkey does not support PRF. Use a compatible passkey.
vaultCredentialMissing: Passkey information could not be loaded.
vaultRevisionInvalid: The stored revision could not be verified.
vaultRecordInvalid: The stored data format could not be verified.
vaultReadFailed: Your display name could not be loaded.
vaultOpenFailed: The passkey could not unlock this value.
vaultInvalidName: Enter a display name of 1 to 256 characters.
vaultRetryChanged: The prior save result is unknown. Reload this page before changing it.
vaultPrepareFailed: The save operation could not be prepared.
vaultConflict: Another update conflicted. Reload this page to review it.
vaultWriteFailed: Save failed. You can retry with the same value.
vaultShareExplanation: Sharing lets the UserInfo service decrypt your saved display name until approximately {expiry}. It does not authorize release to any app.
vaultShare: Share saved name with UserInfo service
vaultShareActive: Your saved name is shared with the UserInfo service. No app is authorized to receive it yet.
vaultShared: Sharing enabled. No app can receive the name without separate consent.
vaultShareFailed: Sharing could not be changed. You can retry.
invalidRedirectBody: This client's redirect URL is not registered.
adminIntro: Verify with your passkey to issue a single-use invitation for a new account.
adminError: The invitation could not be issued. Please try again.
adminReady: Share the invitation code through a secure channel.
enrollIntro: Enter your invitation code and register a passkey.
enrollCompleteBody: You can now sign in to mikaki with your passkey.
